security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown backticks, fenced examples, or documentation links and are false positives. Unpinned skill installation commands and remote image loading remain real risks. The command templates also require safeguards against shell injection and disclosure of sensitive prompts or image URLs.

remediation.issue: Prompt text and image URLs may be inserted into single-quoted shell arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Require shell-safe JSON serialization and prohibit raw concatenation of user values into command strings.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends unpinned npx installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Pin installers and referenced skills to reviewed immutable versions or commits, and document the exact source.

remediation.issue: Image prompts and source URLs are submitted to a hosted inference service.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before transmission and advise them to exclude secrets, private URLs, and regulated content.

remediation.issue: The Markdown preview loads an image from a remote inference.sh host.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a reviewed local image or document that previews may contact the remote host.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images with P-Image
content.value_statement: Image teams need fast generation and editing across several visual workflows. This skill runs Pruna P-Image models through the inference.sh belt CLI.
actual_capabilities: Generates images from text prompts with the P-Image model.
Applies listed LoRA presets through P-Image-LoRA.
Edits supplied images using natural-language instructions.
Combines multiple image URLs into one composition.
Selects standard aspect ratios and lists other Pruna image apps.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI, an inference.sh login, and network access.
Sends prompts and image references to an external inference service.
Documents built-in LoRA presets but does not show custom LoRA loading.
Does not validate output quality, source-image rights, or provider content policies.

use_cases.title: Create Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate square studio images with controlled lighting and clear product details.

use_cases.title: Edit Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Replace backgrounds or restyle existing images while preserving the source subject.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Compare aspect ratios, style presets, and models during rapid design exploration.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image of [subject] in [setting] with [lighting] using P-Image.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a direct text-to-image request.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Style Preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [subject] at [aspect ratio] with the [LoRA preset] style and [visual details].
prompt_templates.scenario: Control composition and a listed visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [image URL] by changing [target area] to [new appearance] while preserving [elements].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Image Composite
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine [image URLs] into [composition], match [lighting and palette], and use [aspect ratio].
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate several references in an advanced composition.

output_examples.input: Create a square studio photograph of white sneakers with soft lighting.
output_examples.output: A completed P-Image generation result for a square product photograph.

output_examples.input: Change the background of the supplied portrait to a beach.
output_examples.output: An edited image that keeps the portrait subject and replaces the background.

output_examples.input: Combine three supplied images into a wide promotional collage.
output_examples.output: A composite image using all references in a wide layout.

best_practices: Describe the subject, setting, lighting, composition, and desired aspect ratio.
Use shell-safe serialization for every prompt and image URL.
Review provider terms and remove sensitive data before remote processing.
anti_patterns: Do not place secrets, credentials, or private URLs in prompts.
Do not concatenate untrusted text directly into shell commands.
Do not assume a style preset preserves every source-image detail.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: Install the belt CLI, authenticate with inference.sh, and ensure network access is available.

faq.question: Which P-Image models are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers P-Image, P-Image-LoRA, P-Image-Edit, and P-Image-Edit-LoRA.

faq.question: Can it edit more than one image?
faq.answer: Yes. P-Image-Edit examples accept multiple image URLs for compositing.

faq.question: Which aspect ratios are documented?
faq.answer: The skill lists square, landscape, portrait, and custom ratios.

faq.question: Does it support custom LoRA files?
faq.answer: No custom loading workflow is documented. The skill lists built-in LoRA presets.

faq.question: Is image content processed locally?
faq.answer: No. The belt commands use hosted inference.sh applications, so prompts and image references leave the local environment.
